blocks.en: 12.0 CCS Governance and Effectiveness Review

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: CCS Governance Structure (CCS 治理結構)：這是指一套正式的組織架構與責任分工，用來監督整個污染控制策略 (Contamination Control Strategy, CCS) 的運作與有效性。治理結構不只是一個委員會，而是涵蓋了「誰負責」、「誰有權決策」、「如何升級問題」的完整框架。
blocks.en: CCS Governance Structure: This is a formal organizational structure and allocation of responsibilities used to oversee the operation and effectiveness of the entire Contamination Control Strategy (CCS). A governance structure is more than a committee; it is a complete framework covering "who is responsible", "who has authority to decide" and "how issues are escalated".

blocks.zh: CCS Lifecycle (CCS 生命週期)：CCS 並非一份靜態文件。它從設施與製程設計階段就開始萌芽，在 Quality by Design (QbD) 活動中被正式納入考量，並在 GMP 生產之前正式建立文件。之後透過品質系統（如 CAPA、變更管制、年度審查）持續精煉改善，貫穿產品的整個商業生命週期。
blocks.en: CCS Lifecycle: The CCS is not a static document. It begins to take shape at the facility and process design stage, is formally taken into account in Quality by Design (QbD) activities, and is formally documented before GMP manufacturing begins. It is then continually refined through the quality system (such as CAPA, change control and annual review) across the entire commercial lifecycle of the product.

blocks.zh: Multi-departmental Team (跨部門團隊)：CCS 的有效性審查不能只由品質部門單獨執行。它需要品保 (QA)、品管 (QC)、生產 (Manufacturing)、工程 (Engineering)、微生物 (Microbiology) 等多個部門共同參與，因為污染控制涉及製程、人員、設施與公用設施的各個面向。
blocks.en: Multi-departmental Team: The effectiveness review of the CCS cannot be carried out by the quality unit alone. It requires the joint participation of Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Control (QC), Manufacturing, Engineering, Microbiology and other departments, because contamination control touches every aspect of process, personnel, facility and utilities.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像 CCS 治理就像醫院的感染管控委員會 (Infection Control Committee)。這個委員會不是只在出現院內感染時才開會；它有常態性的會議機制，定期審查感染數據趨勢、環境清潔稽核結果、手部衛生遵從率等。委員會成員包括感染科醫師、護理長、清潔部門主管、藥劑科等跨部門人員。當發現某項指標出現不良趨勢時，委員會有權限直接要求改善，必要時還能升級到院長層級。CCS 治理結構的設計邏輯完全一樣 -- 常態監控、跨部門協作、明確的升級路徑。
blocks.en: Think of CCS governance as being like a hospital Infection Control Committee. Such a committee does not meet only when a hospital-acquired infection occurs; it has a standing meeting mechanism and regularly reviews infection data trends, environmental cleaning audit results, hand hygiene compliance rates and so on. Its members include infectious disease physicians, head nurses, the head of the cleaning department, pharmacy and other cross-functional staff. When an adverse trend appears in any indicator, the committee has the authority to demand improvement directly and, when necessary, to escalate to the hospital director. The CCS governance structure follows exactly the same design logic: routine monitoring, cross-functional collaboration and a clear escalation path.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的明確要求：Annex 1 將 CCS 的治理與定期審查提升為法規要求。稽核員在查廠時會檢視：
blocks.en: Explicit requirements of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022): Annex 1 raises CCS governance and periodic review to a regulatory requirement. During site inspections, auditors will look at:

blocks.zh: CCS 是否有指定的負責人或委員會？
blocks.en: Is there a designated owner or committee for the CCS?

blocks.zh: 該負責人/委員會是否具備足夠的微生物學與製程專業知識？
blocks.en: Does that owner/committee have sufficient microbiology and process expertise?

blocks.zh: 是否有定期（建議每年）的有效性審查記錄？
blocks.en: Are there records of regular (ideally annual) effectiveness reviews?

blocks.zh: 審查是否涵蓋品質趨勢、污染事件、變更管制與確效活動？
blocks.en: Does the review cover quality trends, contamination events, change control and validation activities?

blocks.zh: 是否有明確的問題升級機制到最高管理層？
blocks.en: Is there a clear mechanism for escalating issues to senior management?

blocks.zh: 缺乏正式的治理結構是常見的稽核缺失。許多公司有 CCS 文件，但缺少「誰在管」和「如何管」的清楚定義。
blocks.en: The lack of a formal governance structure is a common audit finding. Many companies have a CCS document but lack a clear definition of "who manages it" and "how it is managed".

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 的特殊挑戰：對於 CDMO（委託開發暨製造組織）而言，CCS 治理更為複雜，因為同一設施可能同時生產多個客戶的不同產品。CDMO 需要考量：
blocks.en: Special challenges for CDMOs: For a CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization), CCS governance is more complex, because the same facility may manufacture different products for several clients at the same time. A CDMO needs to consider:

blocks.zh: 通用 CCS vs 產品專屬 CCS：設施層級的污染控制（如環境監控、人員培訓、清潔消毒程序）通常有一套通用 CCS；但針對特定產品（如細胞治療產品 vs 小分子注射劑），可能需要額外的產品專屬補充文件。
blocks.en: Generic CCS vs product-specific CCS: Facility-level contamination controls (such as environmental monitoring, personnel training, and cleaning and disinfection procedures) usually have one generic CCS; but for specific products (such as a cell therapy product vs a small-molecule injectable), additional product-specific supplementary documents may be needed.

blocks.zh: 客戶參與：某些客戶可能要求參與 CCS 的審查，特別是對於高風險或高價值的產品。治理結構需要預留客戶互動的機制。
blocks.en: Client involvement: Some clients may ask to take part in CCS reviews, particularly for high-risk or high-value products. The governance structure needs to provide a mechanism for client interaction.

blocks.zh: 全年分段監控：TR90 建議的「全年度分段監控」方法對 CDMO 特別實用 -- 不要等到年底才做一次大型審查，而是在每月或每季的跨部門會議中持續追蹤各項指標，年度審查時只需彙整即可。
blocks.en: Year-round segmented monitoring: The "year-round segmented monitoring" approach recommended in TR90 is especially practical for CDMOs. Rather than waiting until year-end for one large review, indicators are tracked continuously in monthly or quarterly cross-functional meetings, so the annual review only needs to consolidate them.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的組織中，CCS 的治理責任目前由誰（或哪個部門）負責？這個安排是否符合 TR90 所描述的要求？
blocks.en: In your organization, who (or which department) is currently responsible for CCS governance? Does this arrangement meet the requirements described in TR90?

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠發現環境監控趨勢出現異常升高，從發現趨勢到啟動改善行動，你的升級路徑需要經過幾個層級？是否足夠迅速？
blocks.en: If your site finds an abnormal rise in an environmental monitoring trend, how many levels does your escalation path pass through from detecting the trend to initiating improvement action? Is that fast enough?

blocks.zh: TR90 建議 CCS 「最好每年審查」。你認為在哪些情況下，審查頻率應該比每年更頻繁？
blocks.en: TR90 recommends that the CCS be "preferably reviewed annually". In what circumstances do you think the review should be more frequent than annual?

blocks.zh: 如何在不增加過多行政負擔的情況下，實現 CCS 的全年度持續監控？請設計一個簡單的月度/季度追蹤機制。
blocks.en: How can year-round continuous monitoring of the CCS be achieved without adding excessive administrative burden? Design a simple monthly/quarterly tracking mechanism.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: CCS 必須建立正式的治理結構，包含具備微生物與製程專業的負責人/委員會，擁有明確的決策權限與升級路徑
blocks.en: The CCS must have a formal governance structure, including an owner/committee with microbiology and process expertise, clear decision-making authority and an escalation path

blocks.zh: CCS 生命週期從設施設計階段開始，貫穿 QbD、GMP 生產到產品商業化的全過程，透過品質系統持續改善
blocks.en: The CCS lifecycle starts at the facility design stage and runs through QbD, GMP manufacturing and the whole of product commercialization, with continual improvement through the quality system

blocks.zh: 定期審查（建議每年）應由跨部門團隊執行，涵蓋品質趨勢、污染事件、變更管制與確效活動
blocks.en: Periodic review (ideally annual) should be performed by a cross-functional team and cover quality trends, contamination events, change control and validation activities

blocks.zh: 實務建議：透過全年度的定期跨部門會議持續追蹤各項指標，降低年度審查的行政負擔
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: track indicators continuously through regular cross-functional meetings held throughout the year, to reduce the administrative burden of the annual review
